summary: OAuth1Flow class implementing OAuth 1.0a 3-legged authorization flow. Requires optional 'authlib' dependency. Handles request token, authorize URL, verifier exchange, and full authorize cycle.

key_classes.name: OAuth1Flow
key_classes.summary: Runs OAuth 1.0a 3-legged flow. Takes a spec with metadata containing request_token_url, authorize_url, access_token_url. Uses authlib OAuth1Client for signing.

key_functions.name: OAuth1Flow.request_token
key_functions.summary: Fetches a request token using consumer credentials. Requires authlib.

key_functions.name: OAuth1Flow.build_authorize_url
key_functions.summary: Returns authorization URL with oauth_token parameter.

key_functions.name: OAuth1Flow.exchange_verifier
key_functions.summary: Exchanges verifier for access token and secret. Requires authlib.

key_functions.name: OAuth1Flow.authorize
key_functions.summary: Full end-to-end flow: request_token -> browser -> callback -> exchange_verifier.
